promotion_review.decision: Review starts at 100 forecasts, not an arbitrary 300. No output changes the regular Qualified Best gate.

ticket_performance.interpretation: Ticket outcomes are dependent when tickets reuse the same legs. Compare them separately from single-pick accuracy; do not interpret the raw ticket hit rate as per-leg performance.

efootball_adriatic_match_winner.reason: Close-to-break-even favourite returns with wide uncertainty are not proof of value; recheck the latest chronological split.

efootball_adriatic_gg_ng.reason: Do not infer an Adriatic GG/NG record from eFootball GT; the latest stored coverage inventory showed no market ID 29 rows for Adriatic.

promotion_policy.preferred_range: 200-300+ settled observations plus a chronological holdout, not a mandatory waiting period
requirements: independent Match Signal probabilities for the exact market and side
positive post-margin expected value on frozen pre-event quotes
adequate calibration versus the no-vig baseline
positive chronological holdout evidence and uncertainty disclosed
stable exact-event settlement; ambiguous or stale rows excluded
paper-only shadow comparison before any change to production qualification

method_warning: All slices are descriptive and exploratory. Many groups are tested; group results can share events, participants, market quotes, and accumulator legs. Strong/weak cohorts are investigation leads, not causal explanations or automatic promotion/blacklist rules.
